subject: POC kickoff window + hands-on prompt lab / load validation
messages:
From: dylan brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finfarms.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.inference.com, camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff window + hands-on prompt lab / load validation

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We’re excited to get the FinFarms POC running. Suggested plan for the kickoff + hands-on lab:

- 90m kickoff call (stakeholder intros, goals, success criteria)
- 3-hour hands-on lab day (prompt review, routing config, and two short load test windows)

Proposed kickoff windows (PDT):
- Wed 6/23, 10:00–11:30
- Thu 6/24, 14:00–15:30

Hands-on lab options (pick one):
- Mon 6/28, 09:00–12:00 (preferred)
- Tue 6/29, 13:00–16:00

I’ve attached a one-page POC Runbook that outlines goals and the minimal artifact list we’ll ask you to provide. Can you confirm which kickoff slot works and who from FinFarms should join the kickoff vs. the lab?

If neither kickoff slot works, I can open a few more late-afternoon options.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[d] (415) 555-0198
attachments: POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finfarms.com>
To: dylan brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finfarms.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff window + hands-on prompt lab / load validation

Dylan —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick note: our Head of Data Ops will be out Wed (all day). Thu 6/24 14:00–15:30 PDT should work for the kickoff.

For the kickoff attendees from our side:
- Sarah Lee (POC lead)
- Alex Morgan (Data Ops) — will join Thu afternoon
- Priya Shah (Security) — may join depending on agenda

For the hands-on lab, Mon 6/28 09:00–12:00 is ideal. Can you include a short prep checklist for the lab (ports, sample dataset, and any temporary creds)?

Also: can we run a brief prompt pilot during the kickoff (15–20m) to validate routing decisions?

Best,
Sarah

Manager, Machine Learning | FinFarms

From: dylan brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff window + hands-on prompt lab / load validation

Thanks Sarah — Thu 6/24 14:00–15:30 PDT is locked in for kickoff.

Quick follow-up: our engineering lead (Rishi) just flagged that he’s on an exec call 6/24 14:00–14:45 PDT. He can join at 14:45 but we want to make sure we cover the stakeholders piece early so Rishi can catch up to the technical plan. Two options:

A) Start at 14:15 so Rishi can join for the second half (we’d still keep to 90m but shift earlier)
B) Keep 14:00 start and have Monica run the stakeholder intros and goals first; Rishi will join and take over the technical section at ~14:45

Which do you prefer?

Also attaching the prep checklist and a small set of prompt examples we’ll review during the pilot.

Attachments: participant_roster.csv, prompt_examples.xlsx

—
Dylan Brooks

From: monica patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finfarms.com>, dylan brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff window + hands-on prompt lab / load validation

Hi Sarah, Dylan —

Prefer option B so we don’t compress Rishi’s calendar. Monica here — I’ll lead the kickoff facilitation and run the stakeholder introductions / success-criteria section at the top of the call (14:00–14:20).

Please confirm the following for the kickoff:
- Final participant roster (name / role / timezone) — I updated a draft in the attached CSV; please review and reply with corrections.
- Primary success metrics (Latency SLO, per-request cost threshold, acceptance criteria for routing accuracy) — even a short bulleted list is fine.
- Whether Security (Priya) will join — if yes, we’ll add a 10m carve-out for security constraints and acceptance.

For the hands-on lab on 6/28: please make sample dataset available in the shared Drive link below by EOD 6/25. We’ll run two 20m load windows (baseline and 2x burst) to validate batching and KV cache behavior.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/finfarms/poc/runbook

Thanks — Monica Patel
Engagement Lead | Redwood Inference

From: camila reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finfarms.com>, monica patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, dylan brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff window + hands-on prompt lab / load validation

Thanks all — quick technical notes ahead of kickoff and lab:

- Prompt pilot during kickoff: we’ll run 6 short prompts (10–12 tokens typical user prompts) to exercise routing and a quick scoring check. Please flag any prompts in prompt_examples.xlsx that must not be used in public playback.
- Load windows on 6/28: baseline at 09:30–09:50 and burst at 11:00–11:20 (gives buffer for troubleshooting). We’ll run with the small session cache (to validate KV behavior) and then replay the session with full caching enabled.
- Network checklist: outbound TLS to ports 443, 8443; sample dataset location is the Drive link Monica shared.

I attached a short lab runbook fragment with the exact CLI commands and the RPS targets we’ll hit during the two windows.

Attachments: lab_run_fragment.txt

— Camila Reyes
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finfarms.com>

All —

Confirmed: we’ll keep Thu 6/24 14:00–15:30 PDT kickoff (Option B). Priya will try to join for the security carve-out but may drop in late.

Roster is accurate except one small change — replace "Alex Morgan (Data Ops)" with Griffin Lee (they split coverage). I updated the CSV in the Drive.

We’ve uploaded the sample dataset to the Drive link and flagged two prompts in prompt_examples.xlsx as "sensitive" — please don’t include those in the kickoff demo playback.

See you Thursday; I’ll send calendar invites for kickoff and the lab with the final attendee list.

Best,
Sarah
Manager, Machine Learning | FinFarms
